create_get_handle: create a file handle with proper encoding, compression, and storage options for reading or writing
test_is_url: test whether a given string is a valid URL with a recognized protocol
build_infer_compression: build the inferred compression method from a file path based on its extension
test_get_filepath_or_buffer: test translating a URL or filepath into a buffered I/O object with compression args
review_iohandles: review the IOHandles context manager that tracks and closes created file buffers
